note: The PUBLISHED-METRES arm: publish_as_navigation_source is TRUE, so est_x/est_y in frames.csv are METRES and the manifest records navigation_source metric_local with navigation_units m. Its run_id says metricpub so it can never be mistaken for the pixel-valued uevo-fig8-const-homography-rigid-v1 baseline. h0_agl_m is filled in from the dataset's metadata.h0_agl_m by the launch command; it is a mission-setup value, never fitted.
